term.title: isotopes

definitions.text: Nuclides having the same atomic number but different mass numbers.
sources: PAC, 1994, 66, 2513. 'Nomenclature for radioanalytical chemistry (IUPAC Recommendations 1994)' on page 2520 (https://doi.org/10.1351/pac199466122513)
